name: The Pantheon
description:
You stand in the Pantheon — a vast, circular chamber of pale stone that smells faintly of ozone and possibility. The ceiling arches impossibly high overhead, lost in a soft luminescence that has no obvious source. The walls are smooth and unmarked, waiting. This is where all things begin.

The air hums with a low, almost sub-audible resonance, as if the room itself is breathing. You are not sure whether you are alone.
